run_smooth_dual_lp: run the Smooth Dual LP-MAP solver via accelerated gradient descent and return updated BPArrays
run_smooth_dual_with_objvals: run the Smooth Dual LP-MAP solver and return BPArrays along with objective values at each iteration
decode_primal_unaries: decode primal unaries from the SDLP solution and return state assignments for each variable
get_primal_upper_bound: get the primal upper bound of the optimal objective value of the LP-MAP problem
get_map_lower_bound: get the MAP lower bound from decoded primal unaries to verify optimality
